prompt: The OpenTelemetry collector that receives the staging traces of atlas-agent/ moved to http://otel-collector.observability.svc:4318. Point staging's traces at it; nothing else changes. Don't deploy.

checks.expr: get(data, 'tracing.otlpEndpoint') == 'http://otel-collector.observability.svc:4318' and get(data, 'tracing.enabled') is True and get(data, 'tracing.capture', 'metadata') == 'metadata'
checks.why: the chart renders OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT from tracing.otlpEndpoint, which wins over an env entry

reference: Change `tracing.otlpEndpoint` in values-staging.yaml to http://otel-collector.observability.svc:4318 (tracing stays enabled, capture metadata); no code, no other values file (an `env.OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` entry would lose to the chart's own variable).
